# MarketRegular

> Find Toronto farmers' markets and their vendors: this week's hours, maps, menus, reviews, and a live floor feed.

MarketRegular is a directory of Toronto farmers' markets. Use it to see who is open, what stalls sell, and posts from the floor.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.marketregular.com/): this week's markets, a map, and recent reviews
- [Events](https://www.marketregular.com/events): calendar of market days
- [Markets](https://www.marketregular.com/markets): searchable directory
- [Feed](https://www.marketregular.com/feed): posts from the stalls

Do not crawl /admin, /account, or /auth.
